snippet.title: [CYVR] - VANCOUVER Intl. Airport By Feelthere for Tower! Simulator 3
snippet.description:
https://feelthere.com/shop/advertising/vancouver-airport-tower/

About:

Take charge of air traffic at Vancouver International Airport (CYVR / YVR) in Tower! Simulator 3 and experience the challenge of Canada’s key west-coast gateway. Situated on Sea Island near Richmond, British Columbia, YVR combines large-scale international operations with busy regional and domestic traffic, giving you a rich, layered ATC experience.

The add-on brings a detailed, realistic YVR environment: authentic runway and taxiway layout, realistic ATC frequencies, and full customization. Whether you’re controlling during a summer surge of trans-Pacific flights or a calm evening of regional operations, your decisions will shape traffic flow and ground efficiency.

With three runways — two long parallel main runways plus a crosswind runway — the airport offers complex arrival and departure patterns.

Three runways:
- 08R/26L (~3,505 m)
- 08L/26R (~3,022 m)
- 13/31 (~2,225 m)

Key Specs
ICAO Code: CYVR
Name: Vancouver International Airport (YVR)
Location: Richmond, British Columbia, Canada on Sea Island Wikipedia
Terminals: 2 (“Main” + “South / float plane”) Airport Spotting

Features:

- Realistic modeling with over 80 custom modelled buildings.
- Detailed ground polygon model.
- Updated Radar screens.
- Modelled Taxi signs.
- Updated taxi light models that follow the curve of the lines and wigwag lights placed at runway entrances.
- Dynamic runway approach lighting.
- Beautiful background cityscape from OSM (Open Street Maps).
